method: AI-assisted post-generation desk source audit; not a human user study or blind evaluation
denominator: Every returned card, including repeated restaurants across the frozen 12 requests

rubric.pass: All applicable checks supported by separate merchant/source review
rubric.insufficient: No demonstrated failing check but some required evidence absent or ambiguous
rubric.city: Strict requested municipality; Greater Los Angeles metro fit recorded separately
rubric.crispy: Dish-specific crisp/crispy/crunchy evidence; frying alone is insufficient
rubric.fresh_light: Preparation-style proxy such as raw fish/salad; not actual freshness/nutrition
rubric.descriptive_names: Allow unique semantic mapping; record display-name defects separately
